name: CometChat Docs
description: Add real-time chat, voice, video, and moderation to your app directly through Claude. Search CometChat's documentation, fetch any reference page, and pull complete implementation bundles for React, Flutter, iOS, Android, React Native, the JavaScript SDK, the no-code widget, moderation, multi-tenant SaaS chat, and presence — each bundle is a ready-to-run recipe so Claude gets the integration right on the first try. Read-only and no account required. Free for your first 100 monthly active users.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Use this server to integrate CometChat — real-time chat, voice/video, and moderation — into web and mobile apps. Read the cometchat://skills/overview resource first for orientation. Use search_cometchat_docs for conceptual queries, fetch_cometchat_doc_page to read a specific page, and get_cometchat_implementation_bundle for ready-to-use recipes (React, React Native, Flutter, iOS, Android, JavaScript SDK, widget, moderation, multi-tenant, presence). Call list_cometchat_bundles to discover which bundles exist.

tool.name: search_cometchat_docs
tool.title: Search CometChat Documentation
tool.description: Searches CometChat documentation including SDK guides (JavaScript, React, iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native), UI Kit references, REST API documentation, integration tutorials, and OpenAPI specs. Returns ranked snippets with titles and direct links to source pages. Pages for the current version of each SDK and UI Kit are preferred over older versions, and each result reports its version label and whether it is current. To reach older docs, pass the `version` filter with that version's label.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, maximum 25.

version.description: Optional version label from the docs version picker, e.g. 'v7' or 'v5'. Each SDK and UI Kit numbers its versions independently, so a label matches every product that uses it. Omit to search all versions, with current versions preferred.

version.description: Version label of the page's SDK or UI Kit, e.g. 'v7'. Omitted for pages that are not versioned.

isCurrent.description: False when the page documents an older version of its SDK or UI Kit.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CometChat Docs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CometChat Docs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cometchat.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is CometChat Docs MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, CometChat Docs scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is CometChat Docs's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, CometChat Docs scores 85/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 4 of 4 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CometChat Docs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CometChat Docs provides these MCP tools: search_cometchat_docs, fetch_cometchat_doc_page, and get_cometchat_implementation_bundle.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CometChat Docs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CometChat Docs in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does CometChat Docs MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: CometChat Docs does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
CometChat Docs is developed by CometChat Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
